title: Pure Myutant
summary: Myutant cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. The small Myutant Psychics tribute themselves and banish a card from the hand or field to summon a Level 8 Myutant from the Deck. Banishing a monster calls Myutant Beast, which negates Spells. A Spell calls Myutant Mist, which answers Traps, and a Trap calls Myutant Arsenal, which answers monster effects. Myutant M-05 searches a Myutant monster, ST-46 searches a Myutant Spell/Trap, and GB-88 summons itself on the opponent's turn under Myutant Evolution Lab. Myutant Mutant, the newest card, summons itself and banishes a Myutant card from the Deck to fetch the matching Level 8 for LP. Myutant Fusion and Myutant Cry make Myutant Synthesis and Myutant Ultimus, which negates by banishing a matching Myutant card.
